propositions: SupportsIncremental is a @runtime_checkable Protocol with zero implementers and zero callers, making its docstring a false assurance about unused incremental fetch behavior
The reconciler never invokes isinstance(backend, SupportsIncremental) and no adapter implements search_incremental, rendering the capability dead code
Removing SupportsIncremental from _backend.py, test files, and ADR 0035 changes no observable reconciler behavior since full-scan fetch is the only active path
Two unit tests (test_backends_without_incremental_are_detected and test_dc_backend_is_deliberately_not_incremental) reference only the dead SupportsIncremental Protocol and can be safely deleted
Coverage of the isinstance skip-branch behavior is preserved by retained SupportsLinks negative tests after SupportsIncremental removal
ADR 0035 must be amended to correct the opt-in-capability count from three to two and document that SupportsIncremental was removed as a zero-caller, unwired Protocol
